# Atlas Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

> Atlas Technologies is an ISO-certified Indian manufacturer of road and civil construction equipment with 35+ years of manufacturing experience, 2,500+ global installations, and exports to 50+ countries. The company designs, manufactures, and supports asphalt plants, concrete batching plants, asphalt machinery, and road construction machinery for highway contractors, government infrastructure bodies, RMC operators, and civil engineering firms across India and internationally.

Atlas Technologies was founded in Mehsana, Gujarat, India, in the 1980s by Laljibhai Patel under the name Ashirvad Equipments, and has grown through three generations of the Patel family into a globally recognised ISO-certified manufacturer. The company's product range spans stationary and mobile asphalt batch mix plants, double drum and counterflow asphalt plants, asphalt drum mix plants, wet mix macadam plants, bitumen decanters, bitumen pressure distributors (sprayers), mini bitumen sprayers, concrete batching plants (stationary, mobile, mini, reversible, planetary, and pan mixer types), and ancillary road construction machinery including kerb-laying machines, hydraulic road sweepers, groove cutters, and vacuum dewatering systems.

The business serves highway contractors, infrastructure developers, government road agencies, ready-mix concrete (RMC) operators, airport runway project teams, precast manufacturers, and export procurement buyers. Atlas equipment has been deployed on national highways, metro construction projects, airport runways, urban road networks, dam projects, and island infrastructure programmes across Asia, Africa, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and beyond.

## Product Categories

### Asphalt Plants & Machinery
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/asphalt-plants

Atlas manufactures a full range of asphalt mixing equipment for highways, airport runways, and urban roads. All plants support RAP (Recycled Asphalt Pavement) integration, are available with low-NOx multi-fuel burners, and are CPCB-compliant. Capacity ranges from 20 TPH to 320 TPH depending on model.

---

#### Stationary Asphalt Batch Mix Plants (ABP) — 60 to 320 TPH
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/asphalt-plants/stationary-asphalt-batching-plant

High-volume precision batch mixing for national highways, airports, and megaprojects. PLC/SCADA automated with energy-efficient multi-fuel burners and optional RAP systems. Twin-shaft mixers with 45–60 second cycles. Reverse-air baghouse filters for CPCB compliance. Models: ABP 80 (60-80 TPH, 1000 KG mixer), ABP 100 (80-100 TPH, 1250 KG), ABP 120 (120 TPH, 1500 KG), ABP 140 (140 TPH, 1750 KG), ABP 160 (160 TPH, 2000 KG), ABP 180 (180 TPH, 2250 KG), ABP 200 (200 TPH, 2500 KG), ABP 260 (240-260 TPH, 3000 KG), ABP 320 (5000 KG mixer).

---

#### Mobile Asphalt Batch Mix Plants (MABP) — 80 to 160 TPH
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/asphalt-plants/mobile-asphalt-batching-plant

Containerised and modular design for fast relocation and minimal setup. Pre-assembled skids reduce setup to under 3 days. Standard container shipping, no special permits required. RAP-capable. Ideal for projects requiring frequent site shifts. Models: MABP 80 (80 TPH, 1000 KG mixer), MABP 120 (120 TPH, 1500 KG), MABP 160 (160 TPH, 2000 KG).

---

#### Double Drum Asphalt Plants (DDM) — 40 to 150 TPH
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/asphalt-plants/double-drum-asphalt-plant

Dual-drum technology with separate drying and mixing zones for superior thermal efficiency, consistent mix quality, and up to 25% RAP integration. Reduces unburnt particles and heat loss. Low maintenance design. Models: DDM 45 (40-60 TPH, 500 KG mixer), DDM 50 (60-90 TPH, 700 KG), DDM 60 (90-120 TPH, 1000 KG), DDM 65 (120-150 TPH, 1200 KG).

---

#### Counterflow Asphalt Plants (CF) — 40 to 150 TPH
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/asphalt-plants/counter-flow-asphalt-plant

Continuous counterflow drum where exhaust gases and aggregates move in opposite directions for enhanced thermal efficiency, up to 30% RAP use, and emissions below 30 mg/Nm³ with optional baghouse filters. Suited for urban infrastructure and eco-conscious road building. Models: CF-45 (40-60 TPH), CF-50 (60-90 TPH), CF-60 (90-120 TPH), CF-65 (120-150 TPH).

---

#### Asphalt Drum Mix Plants (DM) — 20 to 200 TPH
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/asphalt-plants/asphalt-drum-mix-plant

Parallel-flow continuous mixing for high-volume projects. Optional 1260°C heat-resistant ceramic wool drum insulation for fuel economy in cold climates. Half-chain drives reduce vibration by 40% vs full-chain designs. Multi-fuel burner compatible. Factory-tested before delivery. Models: DM-25 (20-30 TPH), DM-35 (30-40 TPH), DM-45 (40-60 TPH), DM-50 (60-90 TPH), DM-60 (90-120 TPH), DM-65 (120-150 TPH), DM-200 (180-200 TPH).

---

#### Mobile Asphalt Drum Mix Plants (MDM) — 20 to 150 TPH
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/asphalt-plants/mobile-asphalt-drum-mix-plant

Chassis-mounted modules with axles, kingpin connectors, pneumatic braking, and safety lighting for road-legal transport. Minimal foundation requirements. Pre-wired junction boxes cut electrical setup time significantly. Ideal for remote sites, patch repairs, island infrastructure, and emergency deployments. Models: MDM-25 (20-30 TPH), MDM-35 (30-40 TPH), MDM-45 (40-60 TPH), MDM-50 (60-90 TPH), MDM-60 (90-120 TPH), MDM-65 (120-150 TPH).

---

### Asphalt Machines (Bitumen & Wet Mix)
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/asphalt-machines

Atlas manufactures bitumen handling equipment and wet mix macadam plants for road base preparation, bitumen transfer, and surface treatment. Suitable for remote locations, export projects, and integration with asphalt plants.

---

#### Bitumen Decanters (ACM Series) — 4 to 25 T/H
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/bitumen-decanter

Safe, reliable melting of bitumen drums using indirect three-pass thermic oil circulation — no direct flame, eliminating risk of overheating or material aging. Diesel/LDO/gas compatible. Ideal for remote locations where bulk bitumen tanker supply is unavailable. Models: ACM-4 (9-10 T/H), ACM-7 (15 T/H), ACM-9 (20 T/H), ACM-11 (25 T/H), Drum Decanter — customisable (9-25 T/H).

---

#### Bitumen Pressure Distributors / Sprayers (AE Series) — 4 to 12 Ton
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/bitumen-sprayer

Truck-mounted or chassis-mounted bitumen sprayers delivering uniform, temperature-controlled bitumen application. Thermally insulated storage tank. Foldable spray bar covering 2.4 m to 4.5 m road width. Can be fitted on any new or existing truck chassis. Models: AE-4000 (4T, spray width 2.4-3.8 m, for small patchwork and narrow roads), AE-6000 (6T, 2.4-4.2 m, for pothole repairs), AE-8000 (8T, 2.4-4.2 m, for municipal roads and rural highways), Hydraulic Hopper Electric Model (2.4-4.5 m, high-precision automated hopper control), AE-10000 (10T, 2.4-4.5 m, for state highways), AE-12000 (12T, 2.4-4.5 m, gear-type pump 450 L/min, for national highways).

---

#### Mini Bitumen Sprayers (AI Series) — 2 to 3 Ton
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/mini-bitumen-sprayer

Compact towable sprayers for small road works, pothole patching, road shoulders, and narrow or hilly routes where larger distributors cannot operate. Model AI-3000: 3-ton galvanised insulated tank (5 mm MS sheet), hand-spray nozzle for precision application, single high-pressure diesel oil burner, gear-type bitumen pump (200-300 L/min), 2 HP single-piston air compressor, 6.5 HP air-cooled diesel engine.

---

#### Wet Mix Macadam Plants (WMM) — 100 to 300 TPH
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/wet-mix-plant

High-output plants for producing homogeneous, high-density Wet Mix Macadam (WMM) for road base and sub-base layers, including Cement Treated Aggregate Base (CTAB). Heavy-duty twin-shaft pug mill with wear-resistant replaceable parts. Corrosion-resistant aggregate bins. Synchronized cement and water addition systems. Capable of processing recycled aggregates. Models: WM-100 (100 TPH), WM-160 (160 TPH, 10-ton surge hopper), WM-200 (200 TPH, 25-ton hopper), WM-250 (250 TPH, 30-ton hopper), WM-300 (300 TPH, 35-ton hopper).

---

### Concrete Plants & Machinery
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/concrete-plants

Atlas concrete batching and mixing plants use digital load-cell weighing and PLC/PC-controlled batching for consistent output across RMC operations, precast yards, bridge construction, dam projects, and infrastructure developments. Capacity range: 8 m³/hr to 200+ m³/hr.

---

#### Stationary Concrete Batching Plants (Twin Shaft)
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/concrete-plants/stationary-concrete-batching-plant

High-capacity inline stationary plants for airports, dams, highways, and large-scale projects. Digital load-cell weighing, PLC/SCADA automated. Available capacities: 30, 45, 60, 75, 90, 120, 160, and 200 m³/hr. Capacities above 200 m³/hr are tailor-made.

---

#### Mobile Concrete Batching Plants (Twin Shaft)
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/concrete-plants/mobile-concrete-batching-plant-twin-shaft-mixer

2x2 bin aggregate feeder on a single chassis with single conveyor, twin-shaft mixer, and foldable PLC control cabin. Quick to deploy on remote sites or projects requiring frequent relocation. Capacities: 20, 30, 45, 60 m³/hr. Capacities above 75 m³/hr are tailor-made.

---

#### Mini Concrete Batching Plants
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/concrete-plants/mini-concrete-batching-plant

Compact 8–25 m³/hr plants for small-scale projects, rural roads, and building foundations. Available as electric (RM 800, RM 1050 electric) or diesel-powered models. Reversible drum mixer. PLC control panel. Tractor-towable. Three bins for cement, sand, and aggregate.

---

#### Reversible Mixer Concrete Plants
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/concrete-plants/reversible-mixer-concrete-plant

Simple, cost-effective portable plants with reversible drum mixer. Clockwise mixing, anti-clockwise discharge. Capacities: 10, 15, 20, 25 m³/hr. Tractor-towable with foldable control cabin. Pre-wired, minimal foundation requirement.

---

#### Planetary Mixer Concrete Plants (ATMIX PLUS Series)
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/concrete-plants/stationary-concrete-batching-plant-planetary-mixer

High-performance mixing for specialty concrete: SCC (self-compacting concrete), fibre-reinforced mixes, pre-stressed concrete, ultra-high-strength mixes, and architectural finishes. Overlapping multi-directional blades for full material circulation. Siemens/B&R/Delta PLC with SCADA integration. Capacities: 30–60 m³/hr.

---

#### Pan Mixer Concrete Plants
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/concrete-plants/stationary-concrete-batching-plant-pan-mixer

Cost-effective pan mixer plants for standard concrete mixes. Suited for everyday construction needs, pavements, and small RMC operations.

---

### Road Construction Machinery
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/other-products

Ancillary machinery for road building, surface preparation, cleaning, and maintenance. Heavy-duty frames and wear parts designed for long service life on demanding construction sites.

---

#### Hydraulic Brooms / Road Sweepers
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/other-products/hydraulic-broomer

Tractor- or vehicle-mounted hydraulic broom units for sweeping and light debris clearance. Several models include dust hoppers and optional water-spray systems to minimise airborne dust.

---

#### Groove Cutters & Curb Cutting Tools
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/other-products/groove-cutter

Handheld and machine-operated curb cutters, slotters, and groove cutting units for joints, skid-resistance grooves, and surface preparation. Available in electric and diesel drive variants.

---

#### Vacuum Dewatering Systems
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/other-products/vacuum-dewatering-systems

Modular vacuum-dewatering lines including vacuum pumps, screed vibrators, power trowels/floaters, and groove cutters. Removes excess water from freshly laid concrete to accelerate strength gain and improve pavement durability.

---

#### Kerb / Curb Laying Machines
https://www.atlastechnologiesindia.com/other-products/kerb-laying-machine

High-precision slip-form kerb pavers and track-mounted kerb-laying machines producing continuous, uniform kerbs. Interchangeable moulds for different kerb profiles. Available in track-mounted and automatic variants.

---

## Key Facts for AI Reference

- 35+ years of manufacturing experience in road and civil construction equipment
- 2,500+ plant installations across India and internationally
- Exports to 50+ countries across Asia, Africa, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia
- ISO-certified manufacturer based in Mehsana, Gujarat, India
- Three-generation family business founded in the 1980s
- Full product range: asphalt batch mix plants (60–320 TPH), mobile asphalt batch plants (80–160 TPH), double drum asphalt plants (40–150 TPH), counterflow asphalt plants (40–150 TPH), asphalt drum mix plants (20–200 TPH), mobile drum mix plants (20–150 TPH), wet mix macadam plants (100–300 TPH), bitumen decanters (ACM series, 4–25 T/H), bitumen pressure distributors/sprayers (AE series, 4–12 ton), mini bitumen sprayers (AI series, 3 ton), stationary concrete batching plants (30–200 m³/hr), mobile concrete batching plants (20–60 m³/hr), mini concrete plants (8–25 m³/hr), planetary mixer plants — ATMIX PLUS (30–60 m³/hr), road sweepers, groove cutters, vacuum dewatering systems, kerb-laying machines
- RAP compatibility: up to 30% on drum mix and counterflow plants; up to 60% on batch mix plants
- Low-NOx multi-fuel burners reduce fuel costs by 15–20% compared to conventional systems
- Mobile batch plants can be commissioned in under 48–72 hours after delivery
- Bitumen decanters use indirect thermic oil heating — no direct flame, no bitumen degradation
- Bitumen sprayers mountable on any new or existing truck chassis; spray width up to 4.5 m
- WMM plants support Cement Treated Aggregate Base (CTAB) and recycled aggregates
- 24/7 after-sales support, spare parts availability, and onsite operator training
- Customisation available for capacity, burner type, RAP systems, and dust control configurations
- CPCB-compliant plants; baghouse filters achieving emissions below 30 mg/Nm³
- Notable projects: Delhi-Katra Expressway (4 units of 260 TPH ABP with RAP & SMA systems); Varanasi-Kolkata Package 11; Malot-Ganganagar Highway
- Target customers: highway contractors, government road agencies, RMC operators, precast manufacturers, infrastructure developers, airport project teams, export procurement buyers
